Class Upgrader

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Thread
      • nzilbb.labbcat.server.task.Task
        • nzilbb.labbcat.server.task.Upgrader
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Runnable, nzilbb.util.MonitorableTask
    public class Upgrader
extends Task
    Task that upgrades LaBB-CAT by selectively unpacking a given .war file.
